title: BO upload response (CDSL DP, BO_RESP)
purpose: CDSL's result for each line of a BO upload: accepted or rejected, the BO ID, and the error code and description.
linked: Updates the CDSL requests the upload was for: accepted accounts get their BO ID, rejections go to the work queue with CDSL's error
source: CDSL UDiFF Catalogue V3.0.1.4, sheet Field Master, information type BO_Upload_Response (9 fields; names, types and standard values)
